seen.extent: about 35 telegrams subject-tagged codes (Apr-Dec 1899); bunkerhill122 (3 Sep 1899, Bradley to Granger, 17 words); a handwritten code word list (bunkerhill13, MG367_84_102) and a handwritten list deciphering the code of MG367_86-087 (bunkerhill225)
seen.cipher: Seen on bunkerhill122: typed Latin/Spanish-looking code words ('Tegpegeratus me Kellogg option cymbals justin terrovibus maravillar debir verzuckt') with a pencilled decipherment below ('Peperatus: Please send copy of this to me Kellogg. Option executed by Chas Sweeny in the year 1897 to purchase Last Chance Mining Co $400,000'). So a commercial code, with readings and code keys filed in the same collection.

1425.closed: Decipherments are on record in the collection itself: pencilled reading on the leaf of bunkerhill122 (seen), a handwritten code word list (bunkerhill13, text layer seen) and a list deciphering MG367_86-087 (bunkerhill225). Most of the other ~30 telegrams carry no reading, so a catalogue entry is possible only as the unread remainder; verdict left to the session.
